items.text: – Preda de màlmuru. Màlmuru cheret nàrrere meda caru.
items.q: A boy is meant to mispronounce 'marble' and think it means expensive. Is 'màlmuru' a natural child's slip of 'màrmuru', still recognizable?
before: Torra andaiamus. A mesu caminu b'aiat una domo. Su muru suo fiat bellu. Ghassem naraiat:
